caption: The original cast plaque embedded in the school wall: 'Two mile Borris National School March 1846'. The school has been on this site continuously since the year before the Great Famine started, an extraordinary line of community education unbroken in the village for nearly 180 years. Our locally-made blue planter sits underneath, planted up with the village mix of Geum, ornamental Grass and Achillea that we use across all the village planters, around perennials that were already in the box and that we keep in place rather than rip out (May 2026)

Scoil Mochaomhóg Naofa NS, with the original 1846 schoolhouse on the right and the more recent Areas Montessori extension on the left. The morning light is behind the school in this shot, but you can see the full footprint of the village school from the L4202 (May 2026)
